beats.care: The crew and passengers stopped him and landed safely. It raises tough questions about how airlines check pilots' mental fitness and backgrounds.
beats.what: On a Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv on 30 September, the Omani co-pilot attacked Captain Smit Machchhar from Gujarat with the cockpit axe.
beats.why: UAE investigators now say it was a planned plot to crash into Tel Aviv's airport. India's anti-terror agency has opened a case.

cards.body: A reserve pilot, crew and passengers restrained the co-pilot, and the plane landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. According to the UAE probe, as reported by News On AIR, he confessed and had flown the route before. The NIA case uses India's anti-hijacking and anti-terror laws.
The captain is an Indian citizen. Indian law lets the National Investigation Agency probe serious crimes against Indians abroad, including hijacking and terrorism.
